questions.question: The train step returns a loss before optimizer.update. Which parameters does it describe?
options: The final parameters after all updates
questions.explanation: The order of statements matters: value_and_grad runs before applying the update. Use a fresh evaluation call to measure final parameters.
optionFeedback: The order of statements matters: value_and_grad runs before applying the update. Use a fresh evaluation call to measure final parameters.
The computed loss belongs to the parameters used before that update. Recompute after updating if you want a post-update loss.
The data used in the loss determines whether it is held out. Calling optimizer.update does not create a validation split.
